data.one_liner: Get a descriptive name for any given Color using hardcoded color values and closest match.
data.what_it_does: Provides hardcoded names for 2231 color values and finds the closest matching name for any input color. It can be used via a static method or extension methods on `Color` and `int` types.
use_when: You need to display human-readable names for arbitrary colors in your app.
You want a quick extension method on Color or int to find color names.
avoid_when: You require customizable or localized color name dictionaries.
You need advanced color space conversions beyond finding the closest hardcoded name.
strengths: Includes a large built-in database of over 2200 color values.
Convenient extension methods for `Color` and `int` objects.
weaknesses: Limited to hardcoded names without dynamic localization support.
